  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  September 25, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted City Hall; Community Room # A 1St Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias / Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services/ Public Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on September 11, 2025

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Tracy Yeager on behalf of Greater Deliverance Church of God in Christ to host a Family &
  Friends Fellowship Event at 6741 West Blvd; Greater Deliverance COGIC; Private Property;
  on Sunday, September 28, 2025, from 12:00 p.m. – 3:00 p.m APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event within church parking lot. Applicant responsible
  for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable mitigation measures; Approval for a one
  (1) day event within church parking lot; Applicant to hire professional-licesned security guards
  or off-duty LE (congregation members) for the safety of attendees; IPD watch commander
  will be notified and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time permits; Maintain site
  at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant
  and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00406463)

Item #2:  Daniel Witzling on behalf of Bioscience LA to host an Bioscience LA week Event at 101 S.

Item #4:  Teresa Estrada on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a 2025 Harvest Festival Event at One
  W. Manchester Blvd; Inglewood City Hall - South Lawn; Public Property; on Saturday,
  October 18, 2025, from 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for
  a one (1) day event within City Hall South Lawn; Event to be staffed with two (2) IPD officers
  and two (2) CH security officers will be requested via OES Public Safety Supervisor Emory
  Ward; WC will be notified and extra patrol-high visibility provided as time permits; None
  additional conditions for Fire approval; None Code Enforcement conditions; None additional
  conditions for Fire approval;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00406473)

Item #5:  Teresa Estrada on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Halloween Haunted House Event at

  requested via OES Public Safety Supervisor Emory Ward. **THIS IS A FOUR (4) NIGHT

Item #6:  Terrina Scott on behalf of John Hampton - Center of Hope LA to host the Light the Night
  Community Street Festival Event starting at 8th Ave; from Hardy to 94th Street & 9550
  Crenshaw Blvd -Center of Hope LA; Both City & Private Property; on Friday, October 31,
  2025, from 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 1 day event
  within church parking lot; Applicant to hire one (1) sergeant, two (2) police officers for public
  safety and a minimum of four (4) TCO's for street closures / traffic safety surrounding this
  event. Applicant to also hire a minimum of ten (10) professional / licensed security guards
  (wearing reflective vests) to assist IPD with any potential crowd control. NOTE: Applicant
  may use "off-duty" law enforcement personnel that are congregation members to supplement
  the security staffing (same number of personnel). NOTE: MERIDIAN BARRIERS WILL BE
  REQUIRED FOR THIS EVENT; None additional conditions for Fire approval; Appplicant
  must use their own electricity; own trash bins; no water clean-up; dry clean-up (ONLY)must
  have portable pottied; Admin, subject to insurance; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00406468)

Item #7:  Gabriela Barbarena on behalf of Rene Negrete - Inglewood Park Cemetery to host a Dia de
  los Muertos Event at 720 E. Florence Ave; Private Property; on Sunday, November 2, 2025,
  from 12:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for a one (1) day event
  within Inglewood Park Cemetery; Applicant to hire adequate Inglewood Park Cemetery
  security guards / staff for the safety of attendees; Security staff shall wear reflective vests for
  risk management and to be highly visible to attendees; IPD Watch Commander will be
  notified and extra patrol will provided as time permits; None additional conditions for Fire
  approval; None Code Enforcement conditions; None additional conditions for Fire approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO.
  Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00406431)

New Business License Request (s):

Item #8:  Nega Fechisso DBA VPNE Parking to operate as a Parking Lot at 9800 La Cienega Blvd
  APPROVED CONDITIONALL SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment
  of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed license for more than six month
  will negatively impact your license renewal;Remittances of Parking Tax by the 20th of each
  month following collection;Approval for Special Event Parking Forum events only;Special
  Event Parking must not start before 6 pm Monday through Friday;On Site business must be
  closed 1 hour before Event Parking starts.Parking attendant or security guards must be on
  site during event parking at all times;Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off
  site and;No Tailgating;Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in revocation of your business license and any future
  license application requests.(Activity No.00406393)
